og.alt: Feature (@pyreon/feature): You have built this CRUD screen before. Declare it this time.

hero.alt: Schematic: defineFeature with the name posts, a three-field schema and the path /api/posts fans out to generated members: useList, useForm, useTable and useStore. Submitting the form sends POST /api/posts and the list refetches with the new row; deleting it sends DELETE /api/posts/:id and the list refetches again.
